name: Federal marketing rules and penalty amounts for law firms: FTC, FCC, CAN-SPAM and TCPA
description: The federal amounts and duties a law firm's ads, reviews, endorsements, calls, texts and emails run into: the FTC's civil penalty amounts, its rule on consumer reviews and testimonials, its Endorsement Guides, the Telemarketing Sales Rule, the CAN-SPAM Act and rule, the FCC's TCPA rules and forfeiture amounts, and the TCPA itself. One row per amount or duty, with the section, our plain-English summary, the verbatim text it rests on, the date of the section's current version and the date we read it.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Federal marketing rules and penalty amounts for law firms: FTC, FCC, CAN-SPAM and TCPA (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24183838

distribution.name: federal-marketing-rules.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: federal-marketing-rules.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: federal-marketing-rules-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in federal-marketing-rules-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to federal-marketing-rules.csv on id.

recordSet.name: federal-marketing-rules
recordSet.description: The records of Federal marketing rules and penalty amounts for law firms: FTC, FCC, CAN-SPAM and TCPA, one per CSV row.

field.name: lawKey
field.description: The lookup key of the rule or statute (the per-key file name): 16-CFR-465, 47-U-S-C-227 and so on

field.name: lawName
field.description: The rule or statute in plain words

field.name: cite
field.description: The section and paragraph the row rests on

field.name: topic
field.description: penalties, reviews, endorsements, telemarketing, email or calls-and-texts

field.name: kind
field.description: amount (a dollar figure) or duty (something a sender, caller or advertiser must or must not do)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: Our plain-English summary of the quoted text

field.name: quote
field.description: The official text the row rests on, word for word (the other quotes it rests on are in the JSON sources)

field.name: currentSince
field.description: The day the section's current text took effect: for a CFR section, the newest version in the eCFR version history; for the US Code, the date of the latest law in the section's source credit. A CFR section unchanged since the eCFR version history begins shows that history's first date

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day we read the section (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
